demo.title: helmswap-quote.sh
demo.code:
# Add HelmSwap to your agent (hosted MCP, no key for EVM chains)
openclaw mcp add helmswap --url https://helmswap.com/mcp --transport streamable-http

# Or quote over plain HTTP: 0.01 ETH -> USDC on Base
curl -s "https://helmswap.com/api/v1/quote?chainId=8453&tokenIn=ETH&tokenOut=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&amountIn=10000000000000000"

# The response includes the net output, the minimum output, the disclosed fee and a quote ticket.
# build_swap then returns an unsigned transaction. Your wallet signs it; HelmSwap never holds keys.

setup: Add the MCP server: `openclaw mcp add helmswap --url https://helmswap.com/mcp --transport streamable-http`
Run `openclaw mcp probe helmswap` to confirm get_quote and build_swap are listed
EVM chains need no key. For Solana builds, create a free API key at https://helmswap.com/developers and send it as an X-Helm-Key header (an API key, not a wallet key)
Quote first, confirm with the user, then build. The user's wallet signs; HelmSwap never holds keys
